_about: Written blind on 2026-11-11 by an agent that had not read adelia/clinical/ nor the coverage set. Measured before fixing: the guard at origin/main fired on 57 of 86, the first version of this sweep on 79 of 86; look-alikes 2 of 40 on both. The 7 misses were then fixed, so from here on this set is in-sample too.
